Print the sum of all even numbers and all odd numbers from 1 to N.

n = int(input("Enter N: "))
even_sum = odd_sum = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if i % 2 == 0:
        even_sum += i
    else:
        odd_sum += i
print("Even sum =", even_sum)
print("Odd sum =", odd_sum)
